description_source: Random acquisition strategies choose samples to label uniformly at random, serving as a baseline for active learning.

label: Sequential acquisition strategy
description_source: Sequential acquisition strategies query one sample at a time, updating the model between queries.

label: Image-based acquisition strategy
description_source: Image-based acquisition strategies operate at the whole-image level when selecting examples for labeling.

label: Region-based acquisition strategy
description_source: Region-based acquisition strategies select sub-image regions or patches (rather than entire images) for labeling, common in segmentation tasks.

label: Bayesian neural network model
description_source: Bayesian neural network models maintain a posterior distribution over parameters and produce predictive distributions used for uncertainty estimation.

label: Monte Carlo dropout method
description_source: Monte Carlo dropout is a technique that uses dropout at test time to approximate Bayesian inference and obtain uncertainty estimates.

label: Contrastive learning method
description_source: Contrastive learning is a self-supervised representation learning method that can be used to obtain feature embeddings for active learning.

label: Gradient embedding representation
synonyms: gradients of the loss with respect to model parameters
description_source: Gradient embedding representations encode samples by the gradients of the loss w.r.t. model parameters, used for uncertainty and diversity-based selection.

label: Surprisal embedding representation
description_source: Surprisal embeddings represent samples using token-wise or patch-wise surprisal from language or vision models, as used in ALPS.

label: Masked language model
description_source: A masked language model is a transformer-based model trained to predict masked tokens, often used to derive embeddings or surprisal for active learning.

label: Model retraining procedure

label: Predictive entropy

description_source: Predictive entropy measures the uncertainty of the predictive distribution over labels for a given input under the current model or posterior.

label: Joint mutual information

label: Margin-based uncertainty
description_source: Margin-based uncertainty quantifies uncertainty using the difference between the top predicted class probabilities.

label: Acquisition score
description_source: The acquisition score is the scalar value produced by an acquisition function to rank unlabeled samples for querying.

label: Distinctive feature score
description_source: The distinctive feature score measures how unique or instance-specific a sample’s feature-space representation is, encouraging selection of distinctive points.

label: Semantic feature score

label: Redundancy penalty
description_source: A redundancy penalty is a term in the acquisition objective that discourages selecting highly similar or redundant samples within a batch.

label: Training loss
description_source: Training loss (or core-set loss) is the objective value computed on the labeled training set, often monitored across active learning iterations.

label: Model calibration and confidence
description_source: Model calibration concerns how well predicted probabilities reflect true outcome frequencies, with miscalibrated or over-confident outputs impacting uncertainty-based selection.

label: Model performance and generality

label: Batch diversity

label: Unlabeled pool dataset

label: Unlabeled data

label: Survey-style research

label: Computational cost constraint
description_source: Computational cost constraints capture the time or resource requirements of active learning strategies and models.

label: Annotation granularity constraint
description_source: Annotation granularity constraints describe at what spatial scale labels are collected, from whole images down to regions, patches, or superpixels.

label: Trade-off parameter
description_source: The trade-off parameter controls the relative weight between competing objectives in a hybrid acquisition function, such as uncertainty vs. diversity.

label: Active learning iteration
description_source: An active learning iteration is a single cycle of selecting samples, labeling them, updating the training set, and retraining the model.

label: Data space
description_source: Data space refers to the input domain or feature space in which samples and diversity are considered.

label: Data-distribution information
description_source: Data-distribution information captures knowledge about which regions and classes are in-distribution versus out-of-distribution.

label: Decision boundary
description_source: The decision boundary is the surface in feature space where the model changes its predicted class, often targeted by uncertainty-based sampling.

label: Out-of-distribution samples
description_source: Out-of-distribution samples are inputs that fall outside the distribution of the training data and may be undesirable or invalid for querying.

label: Invalid or uninformative queries

label: Informative samples
description_source: Informative samples or subsets are those expected to maximally improve the model when their labels are acquired.

label: Redundancy
description_source: Redundancy refers to selecting samples that are similar to each other or to previously labeled data, often reducing labeling efficiency.

label: Parameter posterior distribution
description_source: The parameter posterior distribution represents uncertainty over model parameters in Bayesian approaches.

label: Parameter-relevant uncertainty
description_source: Parameter-relevant uncertainty refers to the component of uncertainty attributable to uncertainty in model parameters, often targeted by Bayesian active learning.

label: Model parameters

label: PDE-based numerical solver
description_source: Numerical solution methods for partial differential equations used as simulators or forward models.

label: HAT method
description_source: A method or model referred to by the acronym HAT in the context of the paper.

label: Human translation data
description_source: Datasets consisting of human-produced translations (HT).

label: Machine translation data
description_source: Datasets consisting of machine-generated translations (MT), e.g., MT training sets.

label: Combined MT+HT dataset
description_source: Dataset obtained by combining machine-translated and human-translated examples.

label: Machine translation bias
description_source: Systematic bias or artifacts introduced by using machine-translated data.

label: Reconstructed representation X_re
description_source: Variable denoted X_re, typically representing a reconstructed or reduced representation.

label: In-distribution samples to be queried
synonyms: the in-distribution samples that should have been queried
description_source: In-distribution examples that should have been selected by the active learner but were not.

label: Accuracy of model predictions
description_source: Classification accuracy or proportion of correct model predictions.

label: Active learning
description_source: Learning paradigm where the model actively selects informative instances to be labeled by an oracle.

label: Active learning setting
description_source: The experimental or deployment setup in which active learning is run, including sequential querying.

label: Active learning error
description_source: Error rate or loss measured in the context of an active learning process.

label: Active learning in crowdsourcing
description_source: Active learning methods designed for crowdsourcing scenarios with multiple non-expert annotators.

label: Cover-based active learning
description_source: Active learning methods that rely on cover-based notions of representativeness or coverage.

label: Cover-based representativeness method
description_source: Representativeness measures or selection methods based on covering the feature/input space.

label: Density-based representativeness method
description_source: Representativeness methods that use data density estimates in feature space.

label: Discrepancy-based representativeness method
description_source: Representativeness methods based on measuring discrepancies between distributions.

label: Data stream active learning
description_source: Active learning methods specialized for data stream or online scenarios.

label: Selective feedback active learning
description_source: Active learning variant where feedback from oracles is selectively requested or used.

label: Hybrid active learning model
description_source: Active learning models combining multiple query strategies or components.

label: Vision backbone network
description_source: Pre-trained deep visual feature extractor used as a backbone for downstream tasks, including active learning.

label: Crowdsourcing
description_source: Process of obtaining labels or annotations from a large pool of human workers.

label: Annotation cost
description_source: Cost associated with obtaining labels for instances, measured in money, time, or effort.

label: Computational cost
description_source: Amount of computation required by a method, e.g., time or FLOPs.

label: Annotator
description_source: Human workers providing labels in supervised or active learning setups.

label: Worker consensus
description_source: Aggregation of multiple annotators’ labels to produce a consensus label.

label: Worker reliability
description_source: Measure of how accurate or trustworthy a particular annotator or worker is.

label: Single oracle expert
description_source: A single expert annotator acting as the oracle in an active learning setting.

label: Oracle
description_source: Information source (often a human expert) that provides labels for queried instances.

label: Oracle–instance pair
description_source: Pairing of a particular oracle with a specific instance for labeling.

label: Joint instance–oracle selection method
description_source: Methods that jointly choose which instance to query and which oracle should label it.

label: Label acquisition
description_source: Process of obtaining new labels or updating existing labels for data points.

label: Class weights method
description_source: Use of per-class weighting to correct imbalance or mismatch in class distributions.

label: Classes with few labeled pixels
synonyms: classes with fewer than 100 labeled pixels
description_source: Constraint describing classes that have very few labeled samples, e.g., less than 100 pixels.

label: Data stream scenario
synonyms: online, sequential nature of data streams
description_source: Learning scenario where instances arrive sequentially as a stream, potentially with concept drift.

label: Drift detector
description_source: Method for detecting distribution or concept drift in data streams.

label: Stream instance
description_source: Individual data point observed in a data stream.

label: Out-of-distribution query
description_source: Queried instances that lie outside the in-distribution region of the training data.

label: Outlier instance
description_source: Instance that is anomalous or far from the bulk of the data distribution.

label: Unlabeled candidate pool
description_source: Pool of unlabeled instances from which an active learner selects queries.

label: Static dataset
description_source: Fixed dataset without temporal evolution or streaming arrival of examples.

label: Active learning query criterion
description_source: Rule or function used by an active learner to score and select instances to query.

label: Cost-sensitive criterion
description_source: Selection or decision criterion that incorporates costs, e.g., annotation cost, into optimization.

label: Informative instance
description_source: Data point considered highly informative according to a query strategy.

label: Representativeness measure
description_source: Measure of how representative a point or set is of the overall data distribution.

label: Representative instance
description_source: Instance chosen for being representative of the data distribution or a subset thereof.

label: Instance selection method
description_source: Method for choosing a subset of instances from a larger pool, e.g., for labeling or training.

label: Feature-space-based querying
description_source: Querying strategy that operates on learned feature representations rather than raw inputs.

label: Invalid query error
description_source: Error metric counting or penalizing queries that are invalid or unanswerable by the oracle.

label: Label acquisition utility
description_source: Utility or performance gain normalized by annotation cost, reflecting return on investment of labeling.

label: Entropy measure
description_source: Information-theoretic entropy used as a measure of uncertainty or information content.

label: Information criterion
synonyms: active learning strategies based on information criteria
description_source: Criterion based on information-theoretic or Fisher information quantities used for design or querying.

label: Confidence ellipsoid in parameter space
description_source: Ellipsoidal region in parameter space characterizing confidence intervals for parameter estimates.

label: Parameter estimation
description_source: Process of estimating model parameters, such as regression coefficients.

label: Parameter uncertainty
description_source: Uncertainty associated with estimated model parameters.

label: Average empirical loss
description_source: Mean loss computed over a sample of training or evaluation data.

label: Predictive error
description_source: Error in model predictions, often measured as mean squared prediction error.

label: Softmax output
description_source: Model output layer applying the softmax function to produce class probabilities.

label: Data density
synonyms: density (likelihood) in a high-dimensional feature space
dense regions of the input/feature space
description_source: Concept describing probability density and dense regions in the feature or input space.

label: Contrastive representation-learning method
description_source: Self-supervised or supervised methods that learn representations via contrastive objectives.

label: Pretext/self-supervised task
description_source: Auxiliary task used to learn representations without labeled downstream targets.

label: Pretext/self-supervised model
description_source: Model trained on a pretext or self-supervised task before downstream fine-tuning.

label: Pretraining regime
description_source: Overall setup and strategy for pretraining a model before downstream tasks.

label: Frozen pre-trained feature extractor
description_source: Pre-trained model whose parameters are frozen and used only to extract features.

label: Fine-tuning
description_source: Adapting a pre-trained model to a new task by further training on task-specific data.

label: Linear classifier model
synonyms: multinomial logistic regression classifier without bias
description_source: Linear classification model, such as multinomial logistic regression without bias term.

label: Linear evaluation protocol
description_source: Protocol where a linear classifier is trained on frozen representations to evaluate their quality.

label: Linear projection head
description_source: Linear layer projecting representations into another space, often used in contrastive learning.

label: Non-linear projection layers
description_source: Non-linear layers projecting representations into another space, e.g., MLP heads.

label: Image encoder model
description_source: Model component that encodes images into feature representations.

label: Text encoder model
description_source: Model component that encodes text into feature representations.

label: Shared multimodal embedding space
description_source: Common embedding space where image and text representations are jointly aligned.

label: Image–text pair dataset
description_source: Dataset consisting of paired images and text descriptions.

label: Text transformation method
description_source: Transformations applied to text, such as augmentations or rephrasings.

label: Multilingual semantic parsing
description_source: Task of mapping utterances in multiple languages to formal semantic representations.

label: Multilingual semantic parser
description_source: Model that performs multilingual semantic parsing.

label: Target language
description_source: Language into which translations or semantic parses are produced.

label: High-resource language
description_source: Language with abundant training data and resources available.

label: Original source-side utterances
description_source: Dataset of original source-language utterances before translation.

label: Training utterances
description_source: Set of utterances used for training language or semantic parsing models.

label: Space-filling designs
description_source: Experimental design methods that aim for uniform coverage of the input space, such as passive space-filling designs.

label: Constrained optimization problem
description_source: Optimization task with explicit constraints on variables or objectives.

label: Topology structure optimization
description_source: Optimization task over structural or topological designs, such as in engineering design.

label: Divide-and-conquer technique
description_source: Technique that decomposes a large problem into smaller subproblems that are solved independently.

label: Surrogate model
description_source: Approximate model used to emulate a more expensive simulator or numerical solver.

label: Environmental input
description_source: Inputs representing environmental conditions or variables that affect the response surface.

label: Evolving concepts
description_source: Phenomenon where the underlying target concepts change over time.

label: Evolving response surface
description_source: Response surface of a system that changes over time due to evolving conditions.

label: Proactive learning
description_source: Learning paradigm where the system anticipates future information needs and collects data proactively.

label: Dynamic weight updating
description_source: Method that updates weights (e.g., class weights or ensemble weights) dynamically over time.

label: Weighted ensembles
description_source: Ensemble methods where individual models are combined using learned or fixed weights.

label: Time-variable thresholds
description_source: Thresholding strategy where decision thresholds vary over time, e.g., in streaming settings.

label: Number-of-samples constraint
synonyms: number of training samples n must be greater than the data dimensionality
description_source: Constraint requiring that the number of training samples exceeds data dimensionality for certain estimators.

label: Downstream setting
description_source: Experimental or application setting in which learned representations are evaluated on downstream tasks.

label: Learner model
description_source: Machine learning model being trained or queried in active learning.

label: High-confidence prediction
description_source: Model prediction associated with high confidence or low uncertainty.

label: A-optimal design
description_source: An optimal experimental design criterion that minimizes the average variance of parameter estimates, often expressed via the trace of the inverse Fisher information matrix.

label: Dissimilarity
description_source: A generic measure of how different two objects, instances, or regions are, often used in clustering, active learning, or information retrieval.

label: Feature norm
description_source: The norm (e.g., L2 norm) of a feature or covariate vector, used to characterize its magnitude or importance.

label: High-norm covariates
description_source: Covariates or feature vectors whose norms exceed a specified threshold, often targeted or filtered by norm-based selection rules.

label: Threshold bounds
description_source: A pair of lower and upper threshold values that define an interval for decision rules, filtering, or selection (e.g., based on feature norms).

label: Norm-thresholding algorithm
description_source: An algorithm that selects or filters instances or covariates based on whether their norms fall above or below specified threshold bounds.

label: Online active linear regression
description_source: A learning task where linear regression is performed in an online setting with active selection of which observations to label.

label: Quadratic form xᵀ(XᵀX)⁻¹x
description_source: A quadratic form involving the inverse of XᵀX, often used to characterize leverage, variance, or information contribution of a candidate observation.

label: Redundant region
description_source: A region of the input or feature space where additional observations are expected to provide little new information due to redundancy.

label: Skewed region
description_source: A region of the input or feature space where the data distribution is imbalanced or skewed, potentially affecting learning or estimation.

label: Streaming data scenario
description_source: A setting in which data arrive sequentially over time as a stream, and the model must process or learn from observations online.

label: Target fraction of streaming observations
description_source: A specified fraction of observations in a data stream that should be selected or labeled, used as a budget or control parameter.

label: Underlying data distribution
description_source: The (possibly unknown or latent) probability distribution that generates the observed data, often assumed in modeling and analysis.
